title: Social Norm Bias: Residual Harms of Fairness-Aware Algorithms
findings: The paper's analysis of gender bias in occupation classification included 'pastor' as one of the occupations. In the provided visualizations, 'pastor' is shown as a male-dominated profession where the classification model favors biographies that align with masculine norms over feminine ones. This is presented as a data point within the broader analysis of gender-based Social Norm Bias.
